color_space: sRGB albedo; normal maps OpenGL +Y (green up)

textures.description: Photoreal midday equirectangular sky: Rayleigh blue zenith, real sun disc aligned to the key light, perspective cumulus deck with self-shadowing, thin cirrus, aerial horizon haze; seamless at u.
Warm grey-brown oak bark with deep vertical fissures and knots.
Reddish-brown pine bark in flaking plates with dark grooves.
Off-white birch bark, horizontal dark scars, sparse lenticels.
Pale weathered dead-wood bark, cracked grey splits.
2x2 oak/broadleaf cluster cards (green), flat mid-tone, vein detail.
2x2 autumn rowan cluster cards in gold and orange.
2x2 silver-birch twig cards with small light-green leaves.
2x2 pine needle fan sprigs on short branches.
2x2 soft grass tufts: 70-130 curved, tapering blades fanned from a rooted cluster, base-dark to tip-light, some straw blades and seed heads; pale and desaturated (tint friendly).
4x2 wildflower cards: daisy, buttercup, poppy, cornflower, campion, yarrow, marigold, violet.
2x2 fern fronds with serrated pinnae.
Dense lawn/forest grass seen from above (4 m tile): layered blades over dark gaps, light tips, dry straw patches, clover. RGB albedo, A = linear height (blade tips high).
Forest-floor litter (3.2 m tile): dark humus, fallen broadleaf leaves with midribs, pine needles, twigs, moss cushions. RGB albedo, A = linear height (leaves/twigs high, humus low).
Packed trail dirt (5 m tile): embedded gravel, hairline cracks, twigs and dry/damp patches. RGB albedo, A = linear height (domed stones high, cracks sunken); 512 normal map.
Scree and fractured rock (4 m tile): angular plates and chips in grit-filled joints, moss. RGB albedo, A = linear height (plates high, joints low).
LINEAR DATA, not colour: four independent tileable fBm channels stretched to 0..1, mean 0.5. R broad (3 cells), G medium (6), B fine ridged/clumpy (17), A medium-broad (4).
Low-frequency grey-green mottling for macro terrain variation.
Seamless jointed rock face with moss and lichen: carved stonework, dungeon walls and prop blocks. Scattered boulders use 'granite'.
Warm horizontal timber planks with staggered butt joints.
Dark aged structural timber with cracks and iron pegs.
Warm lime plaster with patchy tone, hairline cracks and grit.
Weathered wooden roof shingles in staggered rows with moss.
Ashlar stone block coursing with mortar joints and pits.
Dry reed thatch in tied courses with straw strands and cord bindings.
Stretched hair-side hide, mottled brown with sinew-stitched seams.
Weathered animal bone: ivory field, hairline crazing and grime.
Woven withy panel: upright rods laced through horizontal binders.
Natural grey granite for scattered boulders: quartz and feldspar speckle over tonal mottling, weathered veins, moss in the cracks. No coursing - carved stone uses the 'rock' surface.
2x2 flame tongue cards: orange body, yellow mid, hot core, soft tips.
Tileable animated ripple normal map (OpenGL +Y up).
